summary: Iter 49 — Regression testing after httpOnly-cookie-only auth migration, evening Mira endpoint addition, monthly-report luxe HTML, and Aadhaar pepper migration. BACKEND: 13/13 pytest PASS after 1 fix. Verified (a) POST /api/auth/login returns {user:...} with NO access_token/token/refresh_token in body; access_token+refresh_token cookies set; (b) /api/auth/me works via cookie only (no Authorization header sent); (c) /api/auth/logout deletes cookies → subsequent /api/auth/me returns 401; (d) /api/public/signup-salon returns user+tenant WITHOUT access_token in body, cookies set (throwaway TEST_Salon cleaned up); (e) /api/reports/morning-briefing + morning-briefing/audio (refactored ctx-dict greeting) return 200 with audio_b64+text — no 500; (f) /api/reports/evening-briefing/audio?lang=en returns audio_b64+text+ask_restock:false+lang:en; lang=hi returns Hindi variant; (g) /api/super-admin/send-monthly-report guarded — 403 for salon admin, 200 for super-admin sending to a specific tenant; (h) /api/registry/employees?q=priya returns list (pepper migration lookup path OK); (i) /api/products/import with tiny CSV returns {added, updated, skipped} AFTER FIXING missing route decorator (see RCA); (j) /api/invoices create with customer+staff+service returns subtotal+total>0 (loyalty _redeemable_points helper OK). FRONTEND: /login → /dashboard OK (Miracurl salon), localStorage token is null (cookie-only confirmed on client), page refresh keeps session (dashboard still loaded), Sign Out click clears cookie and redirects to /login.
action_items: Confirm the /api/products/import decorator fix (main agent should sanity-check the diff; a testing agent added the @api.post('/products/import') decorator that was missing from server.py near line 2631).
critical_code_review_comments: Cookie-only auth is correctly implemented end-to-end: server.py login/signup/staff-register all set_auth_cookies(response, access, refresh) and return only {user,...} without access_token; frontend AuthContext reads only data.user; no localStorage token was found in browser after login. Great.

REGRESSION FIXED BY TESTER: `import_products_csv` (server.py line ~2631) was defined without an `@api.post('/products/import')` decorator, so POST /api/products/import was returning 405 Method Not Allowed even though the frontend Inventory page calls it. Added the decorator. Please review to confirm the intent (module-scoped helper vs API endpoint).

logout only deletes cookies client-side — no server-side JWT/refresh-token blacklist. If a refresh token is stolen it remains valid until natural expiry (7 days). Consider a token-version bump or a refresh_tokens revocation table if session invalidation on logout is a security requirement.

Evening/Morning audio endpoints depend on emergentintegrations OpenAITextToSpeech; failure raises HTTP 400. Non-blocking, but consider caching audio_b64 in Mongo (not just process memory _TTS_CACHE) so a backend restart doesn't burn LLM credits regenerating the same day's briefing.
server.py is ~7171 lines — still monolithic. Extraction of routers (auth, reports, products, registry, super-admin) would help maintainability.

rca of the issue: BUG FOUND & FIXED — POST /api/products/import: root cause was that during the recent refactor introducing `_product_doc_from_csv_row(raw)` helper (server.py ~line 2610), the surrounding `@api.post('/products/import')` decorator on the `import_products_csv` function was inadvertently removed, leaving the function as a plain async def unreachable via HTTP. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BACKEND/api/products/import -F file=@x.csv` returned 405. Mitigation: re-inserted the `@api.post('/products/import')` decorator immediately above the function; restarted backend; endpoint now returns 200 with {added,updated,skipped}. Impact: frontend Inventory 'Import CSV' button (Inventory.jsx line 38) was broken in production until this fix.
